units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 1:4">Peah I, 4</cite> <he>ולְקִיטָתוֹ כאחת</he> and such fruits as are harvested all at once (not singly as they become ripe).
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 14b:3">R. Hash. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>בשעת לְקִיטָתוֹ עישורו</he> the duty of giving tithes begins when it is being cut.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 15a:2">Ib. 15ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 4:21">Tosef. Shebi. IV, 21</cite> <he>אחר לקיטתו למעשר</he> after it is harvested begins the duty &c.; <cite ref="Sukkah 40a:3">Succ. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>אחר</he> (<he>בתר</he>) <cite ref="L00690"><he>לקיטה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sukkah 11b:9">Ib. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>לְקִיטָתָן זו היא עשייתן</he> the cutting them is their making (preparing for the religious ceremony); a. fr.
